title: smtp main.rs: dkim_signer.clone() where move suffices
description: smtp/src/main.rs line 235: NntpQueue::new receives dkim_signer.clone() but dkim_signer is never used again after this point. The clone of Option<Arc<...>> is O(1) but semantically misleading — it implies dkim_signer has additional uses. Passing dkim_signer directly (move) would make the transfer of ownership explicit.
